hypothesis: If each of the four Luna sample calls returns two complete files, one following its most likely reading and a hedge that takes the other reading where it is least sure, the judged pool will contain the correct reading on tasks where four independent samples all share a misreading. That should raise all-pass over E002 at the same 5-call cap.
Appending one task-agnostic checklist to every Luna coder prompt raises the per-sample hidden pass rate, and with it all-pass over E002. The checklist covers the failure classes C2-FA2 found:

Choose the Sol call's job after three Luna samples. With two or more distinct greens, keep E002 (a fourth sample, then the judge). With at most one green, Sol writes no-code notes from the task and the three drafts, and one Luna call repairs the best draft with those notes. This raises all-pass, because the judge has nothing to select on exactly the runs where E002 fails most.
